narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -1.71 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.01651-0.01676 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.01708; the first objective pays 1.94R at 0.01637.

plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.01708 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone
